caption: The drawing depicts a detailed rendering of a wooden handled tool with a metal hook on one end, shown from three perspectives: side view, top view, and bottom view. The handle is colored in light tan with wood grain lines, and has metal fixtures attached with small round rivets. The metal hook is brown, curved, and extends from a reinforced, slightly darker brown section at one end of the handle, which is secured with small bolts. The drawings feature fine lines indicating wood texture, and the hook appears to have a knob at its end. Below these colored illustrations are two line drawings of the tool: one a side profile and the other a top view, with a scale noted as "3” = 1’ 0”". The artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner of the page. The background is off-white and unmarked except for the artwork and signature.
title: Bishop Hill: Skate
